messages.subject: Project Juniper - LSA executed
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Logistics Services Agreement has been executed and is now effective, with go-live on 1 July 2026. The fully executed PDF is attached for your records. Congratulations to both teams.

Next steps: mobilisation kicks off this week; Mark Tennant and the Wexbourne ops team to confirm the WMS/API integration sessions.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
